name: Black Magic
overview: Scripture firmly condemns black magic and related practices, warning believers not to engage with witches, wizards, or those who have familiar spirits, as seen in commands to avoid enchantments and not to seek after such individuals (Leviticus 19:26, 19:31). The Lord declares severe consequences for those who turn to these abominations, including being cut off from the community or even death by stoning (Leviticus 20:6, 20:27; Exodus 22:18). Furthermore, God instructs His people not to adopt the occult practices of surrounding nations upon entering the promised land (Deuteronomy 18:9), underscoring His call for holiness and separation from all forms of occultism.
